item.title: Fix lock TOCTOU race: cleanup on PID write failure
item.intent: The mkdir-based lock must not leave an empty lockdir if the PID write fails — a signal or crash between mkdir and echo must clean up, or the next process will see a stale lock with no PID.
steps: Add cleanup after the PID write: echo $$ > pid || { rmdir lockdir; return 1; }
Consider adding a trap for the window between mkdir and PID write
Test by verifying the lock file contains a valid PID after acquisition

acceptanceCriteria.text: Lock acquisition handles PID write failure
Lock still works in normal case
